owner_and_capability: Student Presence — the public modules/studentpresence contract (the presence, session, visit, attendance, status-day, statistics and cleanup facades plus SessionRecords and SupervisionRecords) over its own internal application, ports and Postgres adapter, replacing the dissolved modules/studentpresence/legacy nest; the row types the nest held for other owners move to modules/workforce/adapters/timerecords and modules/careplan/absencerecords (#3422)
atomic_cutover: The four legacy packages are deleted across five commits on one branch, each switching its consumers in the same commit, and the branch merges as one pull request. No package under modules/studentpresence/legacy survives it. The reads and writes keep running through the same repositories, transaction boundaries, lock order and tenant scoping: the session and supervision repository bodies moved into the module's Postgres adapter over record ports the native application already satisfied, and the presence services moved into internal/application/presence behind the public facades the composition root binds. No DDL, no data migration, no second write owner: active.groups and active.group_supervisors stay with Student Presence, the nine active.staff_* and active.work_session* tables with Workforce and the two Care Plan tables with Care Plan, exactly as data_objects records them. The nest carried no legacy.jsonl key, so none is retired and none is added; the 79 student-presence adapter and domain rules that hid its import edges are deleted rather than converted, under the epoch-gated exception of ADR 0036.

The moved suites: modules/studentpresence/internal/adapters/postgres (the session, supervision, attendance, staff-absence and projection repository tests), modules/studentpresence/internal/application/presence (the moved service tests) and modules/studentpresence/internal/ports (the row tests), each with its assertions and two-tenant coverage unchanged.
